title: 模拟权益、Service Class 与确定性路由
completed: service/modules/modelruntime/routing: provider-neutral deterministic routing domain. ServiceClass (policy flags only, never a model/vendor), Entitlement (owner + service class), QuotaReservation, QuotaLedger (in-memory synthetic, atomic per-owner reserve via ConcurrentHashMap.compute), RoutingRequest (validates entitlement.ownerUserId == ownership.ownerUserId, INV-TENANT-001), RouteDecision (tamper-evident decisionNo derived from its own structural fields; constructor rejects a non-matching decisionNo), DecisionHash (deterministic SHA-256), DeterministicRouter.

DeterministicRouter.decide: same request + same registry/quota state -> same selection, binding and decisionNo. Selection reads registry.deployments() (no bypass), filters admitted + protocol + capability, sorts by ProviderId.value() and takes the first deterministically (independent of registry iteration order, unlike ProviderRegistry.findAdmitted's findFirst). External attempt -> ExternalAttemptBinding carrying both requested + execution authorization snapshot ids (INV-AUTH-001) for the ExecutionAuthorizationGuard to authorize at execution time. ZERO_LLM fallback -> DeterministicSourceBinding with no selectedProviderId and no provider_attempt. No eligible deployment -> explicit NO_ELIGIBLE_DEPLOYMENT. Service-class policy gates external and ZERO_LLM; quota fail-closed degrades or returns NO_ELIGIBLE.

JUnit 5 tests: DeterministicRouterTest (20) + QuotaLedgerTest (9) + routingRequestRejectsMismatchedOwner (1). Docker Maven Temurin-25 BUILD SUCCESS, modelruntime module 65/65 (35 pre-existing + 30 new), 0 failures.

Protected-path governance: model-routing-change skill (C3 independentReview) registered + pinned (1.0.0) in requiredSkills; humanApprovals scope=task-authorization (model-routing is independentReview, not humanApproval). R1 PASS (no P0/P1); one fix batch closed R1 F-01 (atomic quota reserve) + F-02 (owner cross-check); R2 finding-closure PASS. precheck PASS, harness unittest 233 OK, git diff --check clean.
remaining: Wire DeterministicRouter into the live execution path: the route decision's ExternalAttemptBinding is authorized by ExecutionAuthorizationGuard and the adapter is opened at execution time (the router only produces the binding; it does not invoke adapters or transfer data). This is a subsequent runtime-integration task.

Persist route decisions (generation_route_decision rows, immutableDecisionNo) and quota ledger entries once a persistence layer for routing is introduced; the in-memory QuotaLedger is a Technical Alpha simulation (real quota integrity is DB-backed via quota_ledger_entry from TASK-0018).
TASK-0032 (next promotable, deps TASK-0020 + TASK-0021 + TASK-0031 all satisfied): minimal ZERO_LLM no-provider-attempt execution path, quota release, and full provider failure recovery.
knownRisks: R1 P3 F-03: decisionNo/providerAttemptId/reservationId canonical strings join fields with '|'; ownership/provider ids containing '|' could in principle collide. Theoretical only -- current ids are UUID-style and never contain '|'. A length-prefixed encoding or '|' rejection in OwnershipTuple/ProviderId would close it.

R1 P3 F-04: RouteDecision's compact constructor cross-checks binding!=null only for SELECTED; it does not reject a binding on NO_ELIGIBLE or a selectedProviderId inconsistent with the binding type. Unreachable via the selected()/noEligible() factories and decide(); defensive-only hardening.

R1 P3 F-05: decisionNo excludes the authorization snapshot ids (consistent with providerAttemptId); two decisions for the same owner/provider/fence under different authorization snapshots share a decisionNo. Intentional (stable across authorization rotation); the full RouteDecision still self-describes via its binding.

R1 P3 F-06: RouteDecision.computeDecisionNo is package-private, so external auditors must re-implement the canonical format. AC recomputability is satisfied within the package (noEligibleDecisionNoIsRecomputable).

QuotaLedger thread-safety (R1 F-01) is added for consistency with the sibling in-memory stores and to close the latent double-reserve; the Technical Alpha router is not exercised concurrently, and real quota integrity remains DB-backed.

same-input determinism is qualified by quota state: decide() reserves quota as a side-effect, so repeated calls on one ledger instance observe decreasing budget; two routers with identical state yield identical decisions (proven by sameInputProducesSameDecisionNoAndSelection).
